# <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="../icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> Float Saturate

<p class="hdue-node-type">VOP node · <code>hdue::substrate_saturate::1.3</code></p>

Clamps a float to [0, 1].

It is part of an hdUE Substrate Material Builder graph, which hdUE prepares into a UE Substrate material; it does not run as a VEX or MaterialX shader.
